title: 第1063章 先替你撑着第1062章 看不透你
slug: 穿越大乾从病秧子开始蜕变
lines: 推荐各位书友阅读：穿越大乾，从病秧子开始蜕变第一卷：默认第1063章：先替你撑着（..la）“你身上的秘密，确实值得他们觊觎！”
“那柄戮天剑，那件能吞噬至宝的混沌金光，再加上这圣人之魂………”
“本座活过数万年，见过的天才妖孽不计其数，但你这样的……本座连听都没听过。”
他说到这里，深深看方云逸一眼，那暗青色的火焰中闪过一丝极淡的意味，如同老树根下埋藏着的一颗没有发芽的种子。
“不过你放心，本座虽好奇，还不至于去觊觎一个后辈的东西。”
“你有你的机缘，本座有本座的残躯，这数万年的风霜，还不至于让本座沦落到对晚辈出手的地步。
但日后，若有机会，你倒是可以说给本座听听。”
方云逸微微点头，没有在这个话题上多做纠缠，继续道，“我上一次以圣人之魂穿过封印，在异域那边与数十尊大能交手，更与摩罗耶老祖和异域的真神境存在有过接触。”
“虽然受到重创，但我也探明那边的一些情况。
如今异域那边对我的圣人之魂必然有所防备，且我此战之后圣魂受损严重，以如此虚弱之态过去，无异于找死。”
“但只要给我一些时间恢复圣人之魂，我便有办法再次穿过封印，阻止它们继续以血浸染封印。”
他顿了顿，目光变得锐利，“前辈只需要替我争取一段时间，让封印不至于在我恢复之前彻底崩溃。”
“我恢复之后，便动身前往异域，解决血染封印之事。
届时，前辈再出手修复封印。”
莫山沉默很久。
暗青色的火焰在他眼窝中缓缓跳动，如同在思索、在权衡。
他那枯瘦的手指轻轻敲击着自己干枯的膝盖，发出细微而沉闷的声响。
“本座可以出手。”
他最终还是开口，声音沙哑却带着一种罕见的郑重。
“以本座如今的残躯之力，尚能勉强延缓封印的崩溃速度………约莫半个月左右。”
“半个月之内，本座让封印维持现状，不至于碎裂。
但半个月之后，若是你那边没有消息，封印必崩，再无挽回余地。”
他抬起头，那双暗青色的火焰眼瞳再次与方云逸的目光对上，声音压低几分。
“至于修复封印四成的方法，你不需要操心。
等你做到让异域停下血染，本座会去唤醒教中那位沉睡着的阵法神师。”
“他若复苏，以封印残存的结构为基，辅以阵法之力重新编织，修复四成不是问题。”
方云逸听到“阵法神师”
三个字时，眉头猛地一挑。
他看着莫山，声音中带着一丝难以掩饰的诧异。
“教中……究竟还有多少如前辈这般的老怪物？先是旷天前辈自石像中复苏，再是前辈您，如今还有一位阵法神师？这圣教在上古时期，究竟是何等庞然大物？”
莫山那干枯的嘴角，终于缓缓勾起一丝极淡、如同枯木逢春般的弧度。
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: Traveling through the Great Qian, Transforming from a Sick Man, Volume 1: Default Chapter 1063: I will support you first (..la) "The secrets in you are indeed worthy of their covetousness!"
"The sky-killing sword, the chaotic golden light that can swallow up treasures, plus the soul of the saint..."
"I have lived for tens of thousands of years and have seen countless geniuses and monsters, but you are like this... I have never even heard of you."
When he said this, he took a deep look at Fang Yunyi. A faint meaning flashed in the dark blue flame, like an ungerminated seed buried under the roots of an old tree.
"But don't worry, although I am curious, I will not covet something belonging to a junior."
"You have your chance, and I have my remaining body. Tens of thousands of years of wind and frost have not reduced me to the point of taking action against the younger generation.
But in the future, if you have the opportunity, you can tell me. "
Fang Yunyi nodded slightly and continued without further entanglement on this topic, "The last time I passed through the seal with the soul of a saint, I fought against dozens of powerful beings in a foreign land. I also had contact with Patriarch Moroye and the existence of the True God realm in the foreign land."
“Although I was hit hard, I also found out some of the situation over there.
Now, the foreign lands must be on guard against my Saint Soul, and my Saint Soul was severely damaged after this battle. To pass it by in such a weak state is tantamount to courting death. "
"But as long as you give me some time to restore the saint's soul, I will have a way to pass through the seal again and prevent them from continuing to soak the seal with blood."
He paused and his eyes became sharp, "Senior just needs to buy me a period of time so that the seal will not completely collapse before I recover."
"After I recovered, I set off to a foreign land to solve the problem of the blood-stained seal.
At that time, the senior will take action to repair the seal. "
Mo Shan was silent for a long time.
The dark blue flames danced slowly in his eye sockets, as if he was thinking and weighing.
His skinny fingers tapped lightly on his dry knees, making a small, dull sound.
"I can take action."
He finally spoke, his voice hoarse but with a rare solemnity.
"With the strength of my current body, I can still barely delay the collapse of the seal... for about half a month."
"Within half a month, I will keep the seal as it is and prevent it from breaking.
But after half a month, if there is no news from you, the seal will collapse and there will be no room for recovery. "
He raised his head, his dark blue flame eyes met Fang Yunyi's eyes again, and his voice lowered a bit.
"As for how to repair 40% of the seal, you don't need to worry.
When you can stop the blood staining in the foreign land, I will wake up the sleeping formation master in the sect. "
"If he revives, based on the remaining structure of the seal and supplemented by the power of the formation, it will not be a problem to repair 40% of it."
Fang Yunyi heard about "Array Master"
When he said three words, his brows raised sharply.
He looked at Mo Shan, with a hint of surprise in his voice that was difficult to conceal.
"How many old monsters like our seniors are there in the sect? First, senior Kuangtian resurrected from the stone statue, then you, senior, and now there is a formation divine master? How huge was this holy sect in ancient times?"
The corners of Mo Shan's dry mouth finally slowly revealed a very faint arc, like a dead tree blooming into spring.
